acceptanceCriteria: The owner confirms the rewrite plan and disables the ruleset for the force-push.
git filter-repo removes only that trailer; the rewritten tree of main is byte-identical.
Every pinned SHA is repinned or its evidence regenerated, and receipt audit, doc checks and the full gate pass on the new main.
Open branches are rebased, the ruleset is restored, and the effect on v0.7.0/v0.8.0 is recorded in BUILD-LOG.
body: Filed 2026-09-24 after the 0.8.0 release. Commit ac80244 on main carries `Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` (cherry-picked from 366d526, merged in PR #70), which lists the claude account as a repository contributor. It is the only such trailer on main. The owner chose on 2026-09-24 to release 0.8.0 first and rewrite later. Measured blast radius at 444f62c: the `main` ruleset (pull_request, required_status_checks) blocks a direct force-push; 500 of 551 commits get new SHAs; 65 of those SHAs are pinned in 109 tracked files (60 .corvint/changes CEMs, 17 .taskman tickets and the release file, 15 use-case receipts, 10 daily-loop benchmark receipts, docs); v0.7.0 (678c1b1) and v0.8.0 (516439f) contain the commit, and published tags are never moved.
title: history: remove the Co-authored-by Claude trailer from ac80244 (owner-deferred rewrite)
